method: split conformal prediction (Lei, G'Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani & Wasserman, JASA 2018)
primary_instrument_meaning: catalogue components subsampled by whole component to a 0.200 % truth prevalence, the midpoint of the 0.112-0.294 % range inverted from the organiser's own published scores

recipes.name: R1_scarp9
recipes.notes: the single winning transform of scripts/search_scarp_radius.py

recipes.name: R2_scarp9_topo
recipes.notes: scarp plus three corroborating fine-scale topographic terms

recipes.name: R3_scarp9_topo_reg
recipes.notes: R2 plus the two strongest regional strain-rate priors (A2 population)

recipes.name: R4_scarp9_topo_reg_mag
recipes.notes: R3 plus magnetic terms, which carry the A1 (isolated) population

recipes.name: R5_scarp9_vacancy
recipes.notes: R4 times the H47-A catalogue-vacancy gate at half power

guarantee.exchangeability_note: The guarantee P(fresh block DTI >= floor) >= 1-alpha is exact under exchangeability of holdout blocks. Geological blocks are NOT i.i.d.; the reported leave-one-out worst floor and the DKW mean floor show how much of the claim rests on that assumption.

repeated_split_robustness.rationale: the certified floor reported on the site is the 5th percentile of the floor distribution over NREPEAT independent random splits of the same blocks, so it is robust to split luck rather than conditional on one draw

selection_rule: hard pre-filters: (i) emitted mass must not exceed the algebraic ceiling S_max at which DTI can no longer reach the target, (ii) folds with truth < 50 px are dropped uniformly; then rank by 0.5*worst-normalised-calibration-mean + 0.5*worst-normalised-conformal-floor over the prevalence-matched instruments, ties broken toward the floor
exchangeability_caveat: The guarantee P(fresh block DTI >= floor) >= 1-alpha is exact under exchangeability of holdout blocks. Geological blocks are NOT i.i.d.; the reported leave-one-out worst floor and the DKW mean floor show how much of the claim rests on that assumption.
